title: werauhia urbaniana
intro: Werauhia urbaniana, commonly known as the 'Urban's Werauhia' or 'Urban's Pineapple Fern', is a species of flowering plant in the family Bromeliaceae. This epiphytic plant is native to the tropical forests of Ecuador and is known for its unique appearance and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Werauhia urbaniana include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions of antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
